src/agent_runtime/storage_schema.py

Python · Tier A

SQLite schema compatibility helpers for durable runtime stores.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
StoreSchemaVersionError 13 Raised when a local SQLite store is outside the supported schema range.
schema_failure 17 Not yet documented
storage_issue 32 Extract typed compatibility facts for an authenticated diagnostic, never raw exceptions.
utc_now_iso 58 Return an ISO timestamp in UTC.
ensure_store_schema_version 64 Validate and stamp one store schema version in a SQLite database. Call before any schema creation or recovery writes. Only a database without application tables is fresh. Unsupported databases are inspected without writes, including metadata writes. Version ranges remain explicit so future supported migrations can be implemented deliberately by the owning store.
